title: LM Caching and Embeddings
summary: This module provides caching mechanisms for Language Model (LM) calls and embedding computations, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous operations. It allows configuration of disk and in-memory caches to optimize performance and reduce external API calls.

nodes.label: Configure Global Cache
nodes.title: Configure DSPy Cache Settings
nodes.description: Sets up the global DSPy cache with specified parameters for disk and memory caching, including directory, size limits, and pickle restrictions.

nodes.label: Initialize Default Cache
nodes.title: Initialize DSPy Cache (Default/Fallback)
nodes.description: Initializes the DSPy cache, attempting disk and memory caching, with a fallback to memory-only if disk initialization fails (e.g., in restricted environments).

nodes.label: Synchronous Cache Wrapper
nodes.title: Synchronous Function Caching
nodes.description: A decorator or utility function that wraps synchronous operations, checking the cache for results before executing the original function and storing new results.

nodes.label: Asynchronous Cache Wrapper
nodes.title: Asynchronous Function Caching
nodes.description: A decorator or utility function that wraps asynchronous operations, checking the cache for results before awaiting the original function and storing new results.

nodes.label: Cached Sync Embeddings
nodes.title: Synchronous Cached Embedding Computation
nodes.description: Computes embeddings synchronously, leveraging the DSPy cache to avoid re-computing identical embedding requests.

nodes.label: Cached Async Embeddings
nodes.title: Asynchronous Cached Embedding Computation
nodes.description: Computes embeddings asynchronously, leveraging the DSPy cache to avoid re-computing identical embedding requests.

nodes.label: Disk Cache Storage
nodes.title: Persistent Disk Cache
nodes.description: Stores cached responses and embeddings persistently on disk, reducing API calls and improving performance across sessions.

nodes.label: In-Memory Cache
nodes.title: Volatile In-Memory Cache
nodes.description: Stores cached responses and embeddings in RAM for fast retrieval during the current session.

nodes.label: Synchronous LM Client
nodes.title: Synchronous Language Model Client
nodes.description: Represents the underlying synchronous language model client that performs actual API calls when a result is not found in the cache.

nodes.label: Asynchronous LM Client
nodes.title: Asynchronous Language Model Client
nodes.description: Represents the underlying asynchronous language model client that performs actual API calls when a result is not found in the cache.

nodes.label: Synchronous Embedding Model
nodes.title: Synchronous Embedding Provider
nodes.description: The external or internal component responsible for generating embeddings synchronously when not found in cache.

nodes.label: Asynchronous Embedding Model
nodes.title: Asynchronous Embedding Provider
nodes.description: The external or internal component responsible for generating embeddings asynchronously when not found in cache.

groups.label: Cache Management
groups.title: Cache Configuration and Initialization
groups.description: Functions responsible for setting up and initializing the global DSPy caching system.

groups.label: Core Caching Wrappers
groups.title: Generic Caching Logic for Functions
groups.description: Wrappers that apply caching logic to arbitrary synchronous or asynchronous functions, checking for cached results before execution.

groups.label: Embedding Caching Functions
groups.title: Cached Embedding Computation
groups.description: Specific functions designed to compute embeddings with integrated caching, reducing redundant calls to embedding models.

groups.label: Cache Storage
groups.title: Persistent and In-Memory Cache Stores
groups.description: The underlying mechanisms for storing cached data, either persistently on disk or ephemerally in memory.

groups.label: External LM/Embedding Services
groups.title: External Language Model and Embedding Providers
groups.description: Represents the external services or models that are called when a requested item is not found in the cache.
